title: Guitar
draft: Claude's draft 2026-10-17 from story_script_v1 §5 (2.3) + §4 (1.6 F4), dlg_guitar_shop ('come Tuesday, I'll keep one aside'), game_components §7 (guitar = sink, noise source), player_profile (guitar lowers stress), infected_behaviour (guitar = noise lure), act4_the_hill (the guitar is part of the first base). The user edits the words and the numbers; then P12 builds it.
time: 'Tuesday' — the first morning after act2_metro_done (the game has no weekdays; a sleep sets guitar_in_stock and the shop's text calls it Tuesday)
player_goal: Buy the guitar; learn three chords.
design_goal: Reward bought with the salary (mid-game rewards every 30–60 min, engagement_guidelines): the wishlist from 1.6 pays off. Reveal: the first mini-game (a rhythm lane) — it is also Act 4's noise lure and a stress valve, so it is built as a reusable system, not a one-off. Relationship: Ananya hears a clip → met becomes warm. Progress: MG Road / Church Street becomes a pocket on the Purple Line.

cast.role: The 1.6 shop owner, now behind his own counter (reuses his sheet). Remembers you: 'Tuesday. I said Tuesday and here you are.' Six-five, no bargaining (his own words in 1.6). Throws in a pick and a chord chart.
A busker by the graffiti wall playing a three-chord song badly and happily. Optional: drop ₹10 in his case → he shows you the G shape (the first lesson starts one star up). Atmosphere otherwise.
Phone only in 2.3 (Chats). Hears the clip; her reply moves met → warm.
Citizens from the shared sheets: café queue, two students with a bookshop bag, a man on a scooter that should not be on the pavement. Atmosphere only.

beats.what: The morning after the metro ride: a text from an unknown number saved as 'Guitar shop' — 'Tuesday. Spruce top kept aside. Six-five.' The Notes entry from 1.6 updates to 'Ready — Church Street'. Maps marks MG Road · Church Street.

Metro to MG Road (METRO · ₹N, ADR-115) or the scooter (RIDE, fuel). Up the station stairs onto Church Street: the new pocket — a pedestrianised lane, a bookshop, a café, the graffiti wall, the busker, and the guitar shop's window with the spruce top. Inside (a small shop interior): the owner, the guitar on the counter, ₹6,500. Pay → guitar_owned; the guitar joins your inventory and shows on your back on the walk home.
beats.economy: ₹6,500 (+ metro fare, + optional ₹10 to the busker)

beats.what: Home, on the cot (hill_flat): interact with the guitar on the wall → the rhythm lane. Lesson 1: G. A strum line, notes slide in on the beat, press (E / tap the big button) as each crosses the line; 8 bars, 70% hits passes. Missed notes buzz, they don't punish. One lesson per evening (sleep between lessons).

Lessons 2 and 3 on the next two evenings: C, then D, each a little faster, the third mixing all three. Each session lowers stress (−10) and is loud: the neighbour's TV goes up through the wall (a line, foreshadowing Act 4's noise rule).

After the third chord the phone offers 'Record a clip?' (Camera, a 10 s take of you playing). Send it to Ananya in Chats or keep it. Sent → she replies ('Okay. That was not bad. That was almost a song.') and her state moves met → warm. Kept → it stays in Photos; she asks about it later.
The guitar stays on the flat's wall as an object: play it any evening (no lesson, a short free strum) for −5 stress, once per night. Act 4 reads guitar_owned for the noise lure and the base.

guitar_shop interior: one small render + spec (Stardew-style interior like the PG room) — wall of guitars, counter, amp, stool
hill_flat: a guitar wall-hook object (sorted cut-out, requiresFlag guitar_owned)
player: the guitar carried on the back (art_pipeline: carried props are a separate layer) — or skip for now
sheets: busker; reuse npc_guitar_shop; crowd from the shared sheets
RhythmScene UI on the HUD kit tokens (lane, strum line, hit/miss marks, one big touch button, progress) — reduced motion: notes highlight in place instead of sliding
item: guitar (items/*.json) — inventory, Act 4 reads it
city.json: church_street on the Purple Line at stn_mg_road (place_church_street already exists)
acceptance: the first sleep after act2_metro_done sets guitar_in_stock; the shop's text arrives and the 1.6 note reads 'Ready'
Maps offers METRO to MG Road (ADR-115 fare) and RIDE when the scooter is owned; both land on Church Street
the shop sells the guitar for ₹6,500 through spend(); a wallet under ₹6,500 shows 'Needs ₹6,500'; no bargaining option
the guitar on the flat's wall opens the rhythm lane; one lesson per night; 70% hits passes; a fail costs nothing but the night
three lessons → three_chords; each session −10 stress; touch and keyboard both play it; prefers-reduced-motion keeps the lane readable
the clip can be sent or kept; sent → Ananya replies and her state is warm
Movie Mode stays green: the generator learns the rhythm lane (a new walkthrough action that plays it through the real input path), and `pnpm movie` passes 13 of 13
open_questions: WHERE is the shop? Draft: a new Church Street pocket at MG Road station (the Purple Line's next stop, as the 2.2 draft promised) + a small shop interior. Cheaper alternative: no new pocket — a shop door at Cubbon Park's Church Street edge where the owner already stands in 1.6, reached by METRO to Cubbon Park.
WHEN is 'Tuesday'? Draft: the first sleep after the metro ride. Alternative: the next payday (so the guitar is bought from the second salary).
PRICE: ₹6,500 flat, no bargaining (the owner said so in 1.6) — keep? Does the pick + chord chart come free?

The MINI-GAME shape: draft = a new RhythmScene (a lane, notes on the beat, E or a big touch button, 8 bars, 70% to pass). Alternative = timed presses on the dialogue card's pills (cheaper, less of a game). Any reference you like for its look (a rhythm game screenshot)? Otherwise I use the HUD kit.
Which THREE CHORDS? Draft G, C, D (the busker's song). Alternative Em, C, G.
PACE: one lesson per night (three nights, draft) or all three in one evening?
STRESS numbers: −10 per lesson, −5 per free strum once a night (draft).
ANANYA: does sending the clip move her straight to warm (draft), or only add to it so 2.6 can still break it? Her reply's words are yours to edit.
2.3b, the optional mature beat (ADR-08, fade to black): the story script mentions it only from 2.6. Draft: not in this build — decide when we co-author 2.6.
The OWNER's name (he is 'Guitar shop · Church Street' today) and the busker's song (must be original or public domain — no real song titles).
